# Kinetic Gain Examples Gallery

> Pick a spec from the sidebar, see its canonical example with JSON highlight.

Interactive gallery of the canonical example documents for all 11 specs. Sidebar filters by category (core / EdTech / HealthTech / cross-cutting). Main pane renders each example with syntax-highlighted JSON, copy-to-clipboard, and links to the spec repo + unified visualizer.

## Identity

- **Subdomain**: [examples.kineticgain.com](https://examples.kineticgain.com/)
- **Spec repo**: [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-examples-gallery](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-examples-gallery)
- **Buyer audience**: Developers · Specification authors · LLM engineers
- **Category**: Hub — examples gallery
- **License**: AGPL-3.0 for spec text; Apache-2.0 for the landing site
- **Deployment**: GitHub Actions FTP CI/CD on push to main

## Pages

- [/](https://examples.kineticgain.com/): Kinetic Gain Examples Gallery — Pick a spec from the sidebar, see its canonical example with JSON highlight.

## Part of the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite

A family of **11 open JSON specifications** for the answer-engine and agent era — five core (AEO, Prompt Provenance, Agent Cards, AI Evidence Format, MCP Tool Cards), a three-spec EdTech trio (Tutor Cards / Student AI Disclosure / Classroom AI AUP), a HealthTech extension (Clinical AI Disclosure), a cross-cutting Incident Card, and the buyer-side AI Procurement Decision Card. **Two regulated verticals covered.**

- **Front door**: [suite.kineticgain.com](https://suite.kineticgain.com/)
- **Quickstart hub**: [docs.kineticgain.com](https://docs.kineticgain.com/)
- **Unified MCP server** (63 tools across 11 specs): [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain)
- **Unified visualizer** (auto-detects all 11 specs): [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-visualizer](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-visualizer)
- **Meta-repo**: [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-protocol-suite](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-protocol-suite)
- **Portfolio map**: [portfolio.kineticgain.com](https://portfolio.kineticgain.com/)
- **Disclosure research**: [pulse.kineticgain.com](https://pulse.kineticgain.com/)
